contracts.signal: Axe Compute 8-K (with Duos joint press release): agreements with Duos Technologies Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: DUOT) adding up to 55 MW of AI data center capacity across multiple U.S. locations, representing over $500 million in expected aggregate payments, in addition to the companies' 10 MW deployment at Duos' facility in Georgia that Duos is in the process of delivering for Axe Compute; initial project readiness is targeted to begin in late 2026 and continue into early 2027, subject to construction, commissioning and performance testing. The companies executed nonbinding term sheets for minority equity investments by Axe Compute in the project entities, with Axe expected to hold 49% of the equity interests, subject to definitive documentation, closing conditions and both companies' approvals.
contracts.units: up to 55 MW across multiple U.S. locations (plus the 10 MW Georgia deployment)
contracts.value: over $500 million in expected aggregate payments
